name: BC subreport 2013
recordSource: SELECT T.IdLista, Produse.DenumireP, Produse.UM, ProduseP.PUTVA, Sum(T.Cant) AS CantT, Sum([cant])*[putva] AS Valoare FROM Produse INNER JOIN ((SELECT LegBCLA.IdLista, Iesiri.IdProdus, Iesiri.Cant FROM (LegBCLA INNER JOIN Iesiri_H ON LegBCLA.IdBonConsum = Iesiri_H.IdBonConsum) INNER JOIN Iesiri ON Iesiri_H.IdBonConsum = Iesiri.IdBonConsum WHERE LegBCLA.IdLista=[Forms]![ListaAlimente]![IDLISTA] UNION ALL SELECT LegBCLA.IdLista, Iesiri.IdProdus, -1*[Cant] AS Expr1 FROM LegBCLA INNER JOIN (Iesiri_H INNER JOIN Iesiri ON Iesiri_H.IdBonConsum = Iesiri.IdBonConsum) ON LegBCLA.IdBonConsum = Iesiri_H.IdRetur WHERE LegBCLA.IdLista=[Forms]![ListaAlimente]![IDLISTA]) AS T INNER JOIN ProduseP ON T.IdProdus = ProduseP.IdProdus) ON Produse.ID = ProduseP.ID GROUP BY T.IdLista, Produse.DenumireP, Produse.UM, ProduseP.PUTVA;
